title: M3 真实模型试点 Provider 终态
claim_scope: 36 个构造案例运行格的 Provider finish_reason、截断失败判定及每组格数；不表示模型质量、教学效果或学习增益

source_invariants.details: 36 cells; 12 per A/B/C; no more than one Provider request per cell; 29 requests total; 26 truncation failures, 3 complete generations, 7 not applicable; max_tokens=512; retries=0.

privacy_export.details: The aggregate CSV/JSON omit response text, prompt text, retrieval text, session IDs, learner IDs, trace IDs, and credentials.

png_visual_review.details: Inspected at full resolution after final render. Title, subtitle, all group segments, count labels, legend, and wrapped caption are visible with no clipping or apparent collisions.

svg.details: Vector output retains editable text elements.

pdf.details: PDF text bounds were checked with PyMuPDF; visual layout was reviewed against the PNG render.

automated_collision_scanner.details: The figure is a single panel; final PNG was visually reviewed instead.

checks.r_locale_warnings: Four non-fatal Windows startup warnings reported that C.UTF-8 could not be set for LC_COLLATE, LC_CTYPE, LC_MONETARY, and LC_TIME. Rendering and R parsing succeeded.

evaluation_judgment.details: Every finish_reason=length cell is failed_truncated, including application-terminal-completed cells; app terminal status remains separately available.

limitations: The sample contains constructed developer fixtures, not teacher labels or human subjects.
26/29 Provider requests ended with finish_reason=length and are judged failed; 16 B/C cells still had an application-level completed terminal event.
One provider-reported completion_tokens value was 513 although max_tokens=512 was configured; it was retained as reported and no retry was made.
Cost is an estimate using provider-reported cached/uncached input usage and official rates; no account invoice was read.
Citation locator counts do not assess semantic support; teacher review and student learning effects remain pending/not measured.
